entries.triggerSummary: Diagnose and fix a flaky test that passes sometimes and fails sometimes without the underlying code changing.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Reproduce the flake locally: run the test in a tight loop and confirm the failure surface
Identify the source of non-determinism (clock, randomness, network, ordering, shared state)
dependsOn: Reproduce the flake locally: run the test in a tight loop and confirm the failure surface

subGoalSkeleton.description: Apply a fix that pins the non-deterministic input (fake clock, seeded RNG, isolated state)
dependsOn: Identify the source of non-determinism (clock, randomness, network, ordering, shared state)

subGoalSkeleton.description: Re-run the loop and confirm the failure no longer surfaces over 100+ iterations
dependsOn: Apply a fix that pins the non-deterministic input (fake clock, seeded RNG, isolated state)

entries.triggerSummary: Bump a runtime dependency to a newer version, resolve any breaking changes, and keep tests green.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Read the release notes / changelog between the current and target version
Bump the dependency in package.json (or equivalent) and reinstall
dependsOn: Read the release notes / changelog between the current and target version

subGoalSkeleton.description: Run the full test suite; capture any breakages
dependsOn: Bump the dependency in package.json (or equivalent) and reinstall

subGoalSkeleton.description: Apply the smallest possible fixes for the breakages and re-run
dependsOn: Run the full test suite; capture any breakages
